literal_meaning: বুকে হাঁটার শাব্দিক অর্থ: বুকের উপর দিয়ে হাঁটা বা হামাগুড়ি
figurative_meaning_en: to crawl on hands and knees
example_sentences_in_english: The baby has now learned to crawl on its chest.
In shame, he is crawling on the ground on his belly.
note: This idiom is often used literally for infants learning to move, but can figuratively imply extreme humility or defeat.
